about: Public-records paper trail for SprayMap California. One row per request to a public agency: what we asked, when, what came back, and whether it is on the site yet. Agencies are named at office level; individual staff are not published. Dates are day-precise where confirmed from the spraymapca inbox, month-precise (YYYY-MM) where reconstructed. 'sent'/'acknowledged' rows with no reply after 30 days are shown as follow-up due. Maintained by the monthly data-asks task; humans commit.

status_legend.sent: request delivered to the agency, no substantive reply yet
status_legend.acknowledged: agency confirmed receipt / assigned a reference
status_legend.awaiting_us: the agency needs something from us (form, portal, clarification)
status_legend.delivered: records received, not yet on the site
status_legend.ingested: records received AND loaded into the site
status_legend.self_serve: no request needed - agency publishes the data
status_legend.published: state published the data; no request needed

requests.agency: CA Dept of Pesticide Regulation - Groundwater Protection Program
requests.program: Well Kit sampling project - analyte list and well inventory
requests.outcome: Full Well Kit analyte list (94 compounds) plus the Well Inventory Database and PLSS layer links. Finding: the screen covers hexazinone and triclopyr (the latter marked marginal), but not glyphosate, AMPA, imazapyr, aminopyralid, clopyralid or sulfometuron-methyl - the herbicides most used in Northern Sierra forestry.
requests.notes: DPR asked us to write a short passage on our glyphosate concerns so they could route us to the right staff; sent 2026-08-24. Awaiting that referral - follow up if nothing by early October. Analyte list saved verbatim at data/dpr_well_kit_analytes.json.
